name: com.blfooz.contextmanagement
description: A framework for building LLM-driven Unity experiences. Manages LLM API providers, context providers, entity and message systems, tool calling, and schema-based prompt generation — designed to keep a persistent, structured world context across your game's AI agents.

samples.description: Chat interface with streaming responses. Demonstrates ChatRequestManager, message history, and token-by-token streaming.
Roleplay scene with character entities and tool-driven NPCs.
